## Product Standards Checklist
See [documentation/reference/PR-CHECKLIST.md](../documentation/reference/PR-CHECKLIST.md) and [documentation/owner-standing-rules.md](../documentation/owner-standing-rules.md).

- [ ] CRUD structure (list + modal create/edit + detail + deferred-countdown delete, no confirm dialog)
- [ ] Delete is hard delete; Archive separate if retention needed
- [ ] Detail sections always render with explicit empty states
- [ ] Shared API/scaffold usage (no duplication)
